data.heading:
Frequently asked
questions
data.text: Can't find your question? Call us, you will speak to one of us straight away.

items.question: Do the prices include VAT?
items.answer: No. All amounts on this page are excl. VAT and apply for 2026.

items.question: Which subscription suits us?
items.answer: With little absence, Pay per service is often the cheaper option. If you want to know in advance where you stand, choose Complete case management. We are happy to work it out with you.

items.question: What does per quarter hour started mean?
items.answer: A ten-minute phone call counts as one quarter hour; a twenty-minute conversation counts as two.

items.question: How quickly do I get a tailored quote?
items.answer: Within two working days after we have discussed your question.
